messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Esperanto, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Esperanto line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------|-------------------|--------| | Vedi | “see / behold” (imperative) | Vidu | “see / behold” | OK | | la | definite article, marks *bestia* | la | “the” | OK | | bestia | “the beast” (direct object) | beston | “the beast” (acc.) | OK | | per | causal preposition “because of” | pro | “because of / for” | OK | | cu' | relative pronoun “which” | kiu | “which” | OK | | io | 1st‑person singular subject “I” | mi | “I” | OK | | mi | 1st‑person reflexive pronoun “myself” | mi | “myself” | OK | | volsi | “I turned” (reflexive past) | turniĝis | “I turned” (reflexive) | OK | | aiutami | “help me” (imperative + object) | Helpu min | “help me” | OK | | da | preposition “against” | kontraŭ | “against” | OK | | lei | 3rd‑person feminine pronoun “her” | ŝi | “she / her” | OK | | famoso | adjective “famous” | fama | “famous” | OK | | saggio | noun “sage” (vocative) | saĝulo | “sage” | OK | | ch'ella | causal conjunction “for” + pronoun “she” | ĉar ŝi | “for she” | OK | | mi (object) | experiencer “me” of trembling | — | — | **MISSING** | | fa | causative verb “makes” | igas | “makes / causes” | OK | | tremar | infinitive “to tremble” | tremi | “to tremble” | OK | | le | definite article introducing *vene* | la | “the” | OK | | vene | plural “veins” (object) | vejnojn | “veins” (acc.) | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | kaj | “and” | OK | | i | definite article introducing *polsi* | la | “the” | OK | | polsi | plural “pulses” (object) | pulsojn | “pulses” (acc.) | OK |
### Items Requiring Attention - **MISSING:** the reflexive/object pronoun *mi* in “ch'ella **mi** fa tremar …” has no counterpart in the Esperanto rendering. A possible inclusion would be *min* after *igas* (e.g., “ŝi igas **min** …”).

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Esperanto script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Esperanto text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 88:** - Original: Vidu la beston pro kiu mi turniĝis; - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- **Line 89:** - Original: Helpu min kontraŭ ŝi fama saĝulo, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- **Line 90:** - Original: ĉar ŝi igas la vejnojn kaj la pulsojn tremi». - Issue: MISSING object pronoun “min” after *igas* - Corrected: ĉar ŝi igas **min** tremi la vejnojn kaj la pulsojn».
``` Vidu la beston pro kiu mi turniĝis; Helpu min kontraŭ ŝi fama saĝulo, ĉar ŝi igas min tremi la vejnojn kaj la pulsojn». ```
